We’re looking for a <strong>Product Support Specialist</strong> to join our Support team at Thinkific.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Thinkific’s Support Team is fueled by empathy and a genuine commitment to the customer experience. Every support interaction accelerates each learning business' unique path to success. We live by our Mantra <strong>‘Serve the individual’</strong>, which emphasizes understanding and addressing the unique needs, challenges, and goals of each customer.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">In this omni-channel role, you will be a key driver for delivering on our vision across all communication channels. You will work directly with our customers—from self-serve to our highest-value Premium creators—through <strong>live chat, email, and scheduled phone/screen-share calls</strong>. You will role model best-in-class support, identify process improvements, and uphold our standards of excellence while helping each learning business extract the most value from our product to fuel their success.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Schedule:</strong></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Hours: 9am-5pm PST</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Schedules: Monday-Friday</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Statutory holiday coverage rotates among the team and is scheduled well in advance, allowing you to plan accordingly. In these scenarios you will receive a day in lieu of the holiday coverage.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Your goal will be to drive best-in-class customer experiences. Here’s how you’ll accomplish this:</strong></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>1. Deliver Exceptional Multi-Channel Support</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Provide timely, empathetic, and technically accurate responses via <strong>live chat, email, and phone/screen-share</strong>.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own each customer issue from initial report through resolution, coordinating with Technical Support and Product teams as needed.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Troubleshoot complex platform issues, including domain connections, payment errors, and integration timeouts.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Investigate and resolve issues involving payment processors, SSO, and other authentication errors.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Identify, reproduce, and document bugs, while ensuring clear hand-offs to downstream technical teams.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>2. Help Customers Succeed &amp; Grow</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Go beyond reactive troubleshooting—educate customers on best practices, features, and integrations to help them scale.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Utilize opportunities for product adoption and plan upgrades (e.g., Thinkific Plus and Branded Mobile).</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Spot early churn signals and collaborate with Support and Customer Success teams to retain and grow customers.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Manage and own complex customer escalations with sound judgment and calm professionalism.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>3. Continuously Improve How We Work</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Champion and embrace an AI-enabled support workflow by leveraging internal AI tools and automation to increase efficiency, streamline ticket resolutions, and enhance the overall customer experience.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Identify workflow inefficiencies surfaced through chat, email and call patterns and propose actionable improvements.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Create and update training materials, macros, and knowledge-base (Guru) documentation to enable your peers.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Participate in feedback loops with Product, QA, and Enablement teams to share customer insights.</p></li><li><p Every support interaction accelerates each learning business' unique path to success. Deliver Exceptional Multi-Channel Support\n\n - Provide timely, empathetic, and technically accurate responses via live chat, email, and phone/screen-share.\n\n - Own each customer issue from initial report through resolution, coordinating with Technical Support and Product teams as needed.\n\n - Troubleshoot complex platform issues, including domain connections, payment errors, and integration timeouts.\n\n - Investigate and resolve issues involving payment processors, SSO, and other authentication errors.\n\n - Identify, reproduce, and document bugs, while ensuring clear hand-offs to downstream technical teams.\n\n2. Continuously Improve How We Work\n\n - Champion and embrace an AI-enabled support workflow by leveraging internal AI tools and automation to increase efficiency, streamline ticket resolutions, and enhance the overall customer experience.\n\n - Identify workflow inefficiencies surfaced through chat, email and call patterns and propose actionable improvements.\n\n - Create and update training materials, macros, and knowledge-base (Guru) documentation to enable your peers.\n\n - Our team is here to guide you every step of the way, so you always know what to expect!</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h1><strong>About the Role </strong>🚀</h1><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Do you thrive on bringing cross-functional teams together to execute high-impact marketing campaigns that drive results?</strong> <strong>We’re looking for a Marketing Project Manager to join us at Thinkific.</strong></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This role will lead the planning, coordination, and execution of integrated marketing campaigns and projects across our fast-paced marketing team. You’ll manage timelines, remove roadblocks, and ensure deliverables are met on time and within scope—while enabling your teammates to do their best work. You will also help us manage our day-to-day operations by organizing the team in Asana, creating systems of organization, capturing and tracking our goals, and building a calendar for the marketing team. Your ability to bring structure to creative chaos will have a direct impact on the success of our launches and brand initiatives.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You’ll report into the Content Marketing Manager on the Brand Team and collaborate closely with stakeholders from brand, demand generation, product marketing, customer marketing, and more. Why does this role sit within brand? This is the most cross-functional area of our marketing team and it is involved in every initiative, every campaign, every goal.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Your goal will be to increase team efficiency and the speed of project delivery.  You will be measured on campaign performance, speed to launch, creative team NPS, and our overall marketing goals. Here’s how you’ll accomplish this:</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Create and maintain detailed Asana projects and project briefs for campaigns, events, and marketing initiatives, ensuring timelines, roles, and responsibilities are clearly defined</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Manage the marketing department’s quarterly planning process from end-to-end and implement feedback and improvements each quarter</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Work with Marketing leadership (Directors and VPs) to prioritize projects, align on deliverables, and allocate resources effectively</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Manage creative team (video, visual design, content design) requests and projects</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Track project performance using appropriate tools, adjusting plans and communications to keep everything running smoothly</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Facilitate kickoffs, stand-ups, and retros to keep teams aligned and continuously improving</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Identify and proactively mitigate risks or blockers that could impact delivery</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Document workflows and improve repeatable processes to scale execution across teams</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including Product Marketing, Content, Design, and Lifecycle Marketing, customer marketing, demand gen, and more, to ensure goals are met</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Communicate progress, outcomes, and performance metrics to relevant stakeholders and adjust as needed. This includes managing review cycles with our leadership team.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>The person we have in mind likely:</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Has 3–5 years of experience in project management, marketing operations, or campaign coordination in a B2B SaaS or digital marketing environment</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Uses AI to increase efficiency and automate workflows when appropriate</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Is comfortable making decisions with limited information and some ambiguity</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Demonstrates a history of accountability for multi-channel marketing campaigns and cross-functional projects</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Can manage fast-shifting priorities and communicate changes with stakeholders with ease</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Is comfortable navigating both the creative and functional sides of marketing</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Has experience communicating with stakeholders across levels — from designers to execs — and knows how to use feedback to continuously improve</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Loves to learn and grow. They’ve found (and keep looking for) ways to level up their skills in this field, whether that’s through formal education, gaining professional experience, or maybe even building their own business</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>These things would also be nice, but we think you could learn them on the job:</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience with Asana or a similar project management tools</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Familiarity with common marketing platforms (HubSpot, Google Suite)</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Understanding of OKR or V2MOM goal setting systems</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Interest in people-first project leadership and optimizing team collaboration</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><em>The recruitment compensation range for this position is $80,000 - $95,000 - $110,000 CAD.
